_about: Government datasets (data.gov.il, CKAN) ingested by scripts/build_gov_datasets.py (the build-gov-datasets Action) into committed, aggregated snapshots data/gov/<dataset>.sqlite.gz (src/gov_data). Every file URL comes from resource_show at build time, never from this file. Model / model-year aggregates only: no per-vehicle record is stored or served. `columns.required`: the build stops the dataset when one is missing; `columns.kept`: stored when present; `columns.never`: never read into a stored, logged or sampled value (the projection drops them while the stream is read). Column names are matched case-insensitively.
